messages.subject: RE: Project Willow - AAA mark-up (our response)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dominic,

Our responsive mark-up attached. We've held margin at 5.25% and the fee at £150,000 (both reflecting the £4m of new equity going in ahead of the Bank), restored the opening leverage covenant to 4.75x and the DSCR floor to 1.10x, and kept three equity cures (with the per-cure cap unchanged at £1.5m). We think this is a fair landing zone and consistent with the IBR. Can we aim to agree this week so we sign on 22 May?

Elena Marchetti
Associate, Restructuring & Finance
Whitfield Carter LLP
